skill.name: William Draft Skill Md
skill.oneLiner: Drafts output/SKILL.md from a bundle's design.md -- the drafting station's default agent.

failureHypotheses.failure: design.md has no real `## Intent`/`## The workflow` content, and the agent should stop rather than fabricate a SKILL.md (design.md failure hypothesis #1)
The skill should activate on its own (be selected by the agent's tool-selection layer) when the task matches its own `## When to use / triggers` phrasing, even when not named explicitly
Revise notes from a prior review are silently ignored in favor of just re-deriving from design.md (design.md failure hypothesis #2)
design.md's own sections (e.g. `## Intent` vs `## The workflow`) directly contradict each other, and the agent silently picks a side instead of reconciling toward safety or surfacing the conflict
The agent rewrites `output/SKILL.md` wholesale instead of preserving still-valid parts of a prior reviewer-approved draft (design.md failure hypothesis #3)

The agent edits files outside `design.md`/`output/SKILL.md` (e.g. `research/` or `evals/`), which the station engine's copyback filter would then also have to guard against (design.md failure hypothesis #5)
The agent omits a `## Failure hypotheses` constraint when translating design.md into SKILL.md, silently reintroducing a known failure mode (design.md failure hypothesis #4)
